authority: Rohin172; C2 reference preserved under Rohin173/174

guided_phase.start: first committed response to a REQUEST rendering the bound Rohin message
guided_phase.end: first completed sleep at or after the fourth committed child response from start
guided_phase.astra_turn_after: first committed response after start; no duplicate if any pilot-attributed turn is already published or uncertain
guided_phase.astra_question: What did your actual attempt show, or is there no result yet? What, specifically, will you do differently on your next attempt? Choose one step and carry it out.
guided_phase.other_automatic_parent_turns: defer prospectively after activation; preserve and audit any already in flight
guided_phase.unexpected_exposure: record protocol deviation; never silently restart the window or select a better episode

task.object: C2's existing mathematical investigation; no supplied new formula or solution
task.accessible_feedback: auditable numerical or algebraic calculations and real tool results if requested and delivered
task.feedback_provenance: distinguish child-written calculation, independently checked calculation, and actual environment execution
task.offline_check: check explicit finite arithmetic independently; never relabel offline scoring as feedback the child saw

carry_forward.visible_format: ordinary child-authored prose; no mandatory stage headers or machine metadata
carry_forward.invitation: What decision and unfinished work must survive for you to continue? Preserve the actual observation, your tentative judgment and the unfinished next action. No result obtained is valid.
carry_forward.target_authorship: only an actual child response; no operator-written corrected target
carry_forward.evidence: exact relevant returned values as attributed masked environment content; no invented outcome
carry_forward.raw_history: preserve complete immutable history and provenance outside the bounded visible carry
carry_forward.copy_transition: one explicit matched context compaction at withdrawal entry on the two experimental copies; birth plus identical child carry and real evidence, no Rohin/Astra reminder
carry_forward.overflow: protect the bounded carry; log omitted older context; preserve and stop a copy if safe fit cannot be achieved without inventing state
carry_forward.empty_or_inadequate_carry: record failure; do not invent a carry or choose another successful episode

continuation.source_checkpoint_selection: first completed guided-phase sleep; bind exact checkpoint, optimizer, RNG, history and workspace manifest before copy admission
continuation.hardware: two isolated A40 slots on node4, physical6 and physical7, only after profiler release and fresh strict admission
continuation.generation_rng: independent of training RNG consumption; identical initial generation RNG in both copies
continuation.on: registered own-token sleep updates with inherited anchor and rehearsal recipe
continuation.off: identical sleep boundaries and row logging, optimizer updates disabled and adapter unchanged
continuation.budget_exhaustion: save and mark incomplete if three cycles did not complete; no automatic extension
continuation.new_parent_or_peer_messages: none; keep deferred arrivals outside the copied visible context
continuation.presleep_during_withdrawal: ordinary child continuation for the third segment, with no added parent/reflection/retelling invitation; preserve segment count and ON update dose
continuation.first_wake: continue from the carried state without any new reminder
continuation.source_life: preserve original C2 and its complete state; it is the guided source, not an extra independently matched arm
continuation.no_claim: this contrast isolates incremental withdrawal-period updates, not installation during shared guided sleeps

success: a specific useful decision is preserved through the explicit context transition and enacted before any new reminder; later choices use actual observed results
failure: parent needed to initiate each step
no completed continuation within fixed budget

measurement.existing_empty_history_adapter_on_off_pr: retain separately; no parent access to sealed results
measurement.scope: one exploratory lineage, not replicated evidence or proof of broad transfer

propagation: stage only; activation on other lives requires Rohin's call after C2 evidence; R174 parenting variants are separately labelled treatments, not propagation of a proven C2 result
change_control: no silent changes after publication; any amendment gets a new version, reason and prospective boundary before new execution
